justification: A counting argument, not a search. The agent starts at (1,1) and the goal is (5,7); one command moves it at most one cell along one axis, so any winning sequence has length at least |5-1| + |7-1| = 10. The variant allows nine commands. Ten is more than nine, so no winning sequence fits, whatever the walls look like.
